title: When Baby Joshua Cried
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Baby Joshua is sick and everyone is tired. Sanyu struggles with jealousy but sees Mercy's selfless love.
keywords: patience, jealousy, serving, siblings, Uganda, girls, virtue, baby
dedication: For every girl learning to serve even when it is hard.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: When Baby Joshua gets sick, Sanyu feels invisible. But watching Mercy serve without complaint plants a new seed in her heart.
